Not an SCE and production continues, so not scored 9-10.

urgency.rationale: derived 8.3 from impact 8 and likelihood 9, impact weighted. Band: this week.

tickets.recommended_action: Isolate and inspect P-3305 diaphragm and discharge check valves, replace the diaphragm, and test discharge pressure before return.
